description: Audit routed copper traces and circular arcs in a .kicad_pcb or Specctra .dsn design against commercial PCB fabrication Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) minimum trace width limits. Call this tool before fabrication export or after manual layout edits to verify compliance with JLCPCB, PCBWay, or Sierra Circuits capabilities. Accepts raw pcb_text (or local project_path) and a fab_tier ('standard_2l', 'standard_4l', or 'fine_hdi') using millimeter (mm) dimensions. Returns JSON with fab_tier, checked_segments, min_observed_trace_width_mm, and boolean dfm_passed; if dfm_passed is false, run calligraphy_compile_board with requested_sku='dfm_fix'.

fab_tier.description: Target fabrication capability tier: 'standard_2l' (0.127 mm / 5 mil), 'standard_4l' (0.090 mm / 3.5 mil), or 'fine_hdi' (0.075 mm / 3 mil).

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 .kicad_pcb or Specctra .dsn file content containing routed '(segment ... (width ...))' or '(arc ...)' elements in millimeters (mm).

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to a .kicad_pcb or .dsn file when running in local STDIO mode. Example: 'board.kicad_pcb'.

name: audit_pcb_dfm_rules
title: Audit PCB DFM Fabrication Rules
